theorem: Cross-layer 61-Core Theorem.  Let K=ker(d1)∩ker(Hx_plus) in the 240-edge F_3 carrier.  Then dim K=165=15*11.  The triangle-boundary stabilizers contribute 88=2^3*11 dimensions inside K, the line stabilizers contribute 16=2^4, and together they contribute 104=2^3*13.  The shared logical quotient therefore has dimension 61.  Equivalently, 61=q^mu-lambda*Phi4=81-20 and also 61=mu^q-q=64-3, the sense-codon count.  Thus the overlap of the homological physics layer and the all-plus line/readout layer is a prime core whose size is the same finite rank used by the genetic-code dictionary.
